name: Shimea (son of Bathsheba)
title: David's son with Bathsheba
summary: Shimea was one of the sons of King David and Bathsheba, born in Jerusalem after David became king over all Israel. He was a brother to Solomon, who later became king, and is mentioned in the genealogies as one of the royal sons.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned among David's sons in Jerusalem
keyEvents.description: Shimea is listed as one of the sons David had with Bathsheba (Bat-Shua) after he became king in Jerusalem.

keyEvents.title: Born as a royal son
keyEvents.description: Shimea was born as part of the royal family in Jerusalem, one of four sons David had with Bathsheba.
